== Description ==
'''SHA-35''' is the one of the many Shadow entities found within the [[Shadow Challenge]] and the [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse]] modifier. He is the infected counterpart of [[D-35]].

== Behavior ==
'''SHA-35''' is a entity that you'll be forced to find in the [[Shadow Challenge]]. '''SHA-35''' will act like [[D-35]] except that it will be much slower than his own [[D-35|uninfected counterpart]]. Upon spawning, it will emit a loud, low-tuned sound, the same spawn sound from his [[D-35|uninfected counterpart]], but pitched down. He will rush to the main room at a medium speed, and upon reaching the main room, he will rebound and go back to the void wall. '''SHA-35''' will rebound 2-4 times before despawning, sinking into the ground like [[D-35]].

== Strategy & Tips ==

* When '''SHA-35''' spawns in, avoid rushing too much forward to avoid getting multiple '''SHA-35'''s spawned.
** This applies especially to [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse]], as it is much more common in that [[Modifiers|modifier]].
* When '''SHA-35''' approaches you, it will emit a very slight screenshake, so you need to be aware of it.
* When '''SHA-35''' is approaching you while other entities are active, try to hide as late as possible to avoid unnecessary [[Claustrophobia]] damage. '''SHA-35''' cannot lockersnipe you, so use it to your advantage.

== Trivia ==
SHA-35 is the only shadow entity that you can survive by hiding under a table.
